svg.text: Coordinates as a sketch uses them, in every module orientation that fits the module
setDot(X, Y): X from the left, Y from the top; module 0 is the far end of the chain from DIN.
Red: the bits of setColumn(5, value), bit 0 at the top.
Blue: the bits of setRow(2, 2, value), one row of one module, bit 7 on the left.
